files.freeWholeCelClipboard20261030: Legacy copySelectedAnimationCels/snapshotLinkedAnimationCels/pasteAnimationCels with workspace-cut and deleteSelectedAnimationItems: same-document whole free Cel snapshots preserve ordered instances, source references, pixel cache geometry, opacity/zIndex and block offsets.
